SNEAK_ATTACK.title: Sneak Attack
SNEAK_ATTACK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
[gold]Ambush[/gold]: Deal {AmbushDamage:diff()} additional damage and apply {AmbushWeak:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
HUNT_OPERATION.title: Cover
HUNT_OPERATION.description:
Gain {CalculationExtra:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each card in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold].
Bring out all of those cards.
TIGER_COMBO.title: Tiger Frenzy
TIGER_COMBO.description: Apply {RendPower:diff()} [gold]Rend[/gold]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the card brought out from your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] is an Attack, play this card again.
WIDENED_NET.title: Cast the Net
EXPANSION.title: Expansion
CLAW_SWIPE.title: Strike
FUR_GUARD.title: Defend
GATHER_MOMENTUM.title: Gather Momentum
GATHER_MOMENTUM.description: Attacks and Skills in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] grant {Repeat:diff} additional [gold]Strength[/gold]/[gold]Dexterity[/gold].
FROST_COAT.title: Frost Coat
FROST_STRIKE.title: Snowball Toss
LEOPARD_BITE.title: Leopard Bite
SET_AMBUSH.title: Set Ambush
INGENUITY.title: Ingenuity
WARM_SNOW.title: Warm Snow
FROZEN_ADEPT_CARD.title: Frost Echo
AMBUSH_STRIKE.title: Ambush Strike
AMBUSH_STANCE.title: Normal Form
AMBUSH_STANCE.description:
When you play a card, the earliest card added to your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] is brought out.
Right-click to switch to [gold]Ambush form[/gold].
AMBUSH_STANCE.ambushDescription:
When you play a card, its effect does not trigger and it is added to your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold].
Right-click to switch to normal form.
OVERLOAD.title: Overload
OVERLOAD.description:
For each card in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold], gain 1 [gold]Energy[/gold] and draw 1 card.
Your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] is disabled next turn.
AMBUSH_POUNCE.title: Ambush Pounce
AMBUSH_POUNCE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Ambush[/gold]: Instead, deal damage to ALL enemies, +{AmbushBonus:diff()} damage.
THROAT_GRIP.title: Throat Grip
THROAT_GRIP.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
[gold]Ambush[/gold]: Deal {AmbushDamage:diff()} additional damage and apply {AmbushVulnerable:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
HOLD_BREATH.title: Hold Breath
KILLER_INSTINCT.title: Ambush Instinct
KILLER_INSTINCT.description: The first time each turn a card is added to your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()}; the first time a card is brought out, draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
REGROUP.title: Regroup
REGROUP.description:
Bring out 1 chosen card from your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] and trigger its [gold]Ambush[/gold] effect.
Then add 1 card from your hand to your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold].
CLOSE_THE_NET.title: Close the Net
CLOSE_THE_NET.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Choose 1 card in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] to bring out.
AMBUSH_ECHO.title: Hidden Troops
CALAMITY_FORM.title: Hunting Form
CALAMITY_FORM.description:
Your attacks ignore [gold]Block[/gold].
At the start of your turn, apply 1 [gold]Opening[/gold] to ALL enemies.
DAM_BREAK.title: Surprise Attack
DAM_BREAK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
[gold]Ambush[/gold]: Deal {AmbushDamage:diff()} additional damage and apply {AmbushWeak:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
DEEP_BITE.title: Hamstring
DEEP_BITE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
[gold]Ambush[/gold]: If this enemy does not intend to attack, [gold]Stun[/gold] it.
FROST_FANG_CARD.title: Frost Fang
FROST_FANG_CARD.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold], adding its damage to this card.
[gold]Ambush[/gold]: Lose {HpLoss:diff()} [gold]HP[/gold], then deal an additional {AmbushDamage:diff()} damage.
FROST_FANG_CARD.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose a card in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] to [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
TRACK.title: Hunt Down
AMBUSH_BARRAGE.title: Myriad Ambushes
AMBUSH_BARRAGE.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Ambush[/gold]: Gain all differently named [gold]Ambush[/gold] effects that have triggered this combat. For every 2 effects gained, this card costs 1 more and deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage.
FOLLOW_THE_TRAIL.title: Follow the Trail
FOLLOW_THE_TRAIL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If this card is in your [gold]discard pile[/gold], it enters your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] at the start of the turn.
SNOW_SURGE.title: Momentum
SNOW_SURGE.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each card you played this turn.
WHET_CLAW.title: Whet Claws
WHET_CLAW.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. All copies of [gold]Whet Claws[/gold] deal {WhetClawPower:diff()} more damage this combat.
[gold]Ambush[/gold]: Play this card an additional time.
READY_FOR_ANYTHING.title: Ready for Anything
READY_FOR_ANYTHING.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Costs {Energy:energyIcons()} less for each card in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold].
NIGHT_PATROL.title: Dark Harvest
NIGHT_PATROL.description: After the first card is brought out of your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] each turn, gain {NightPatrolPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] and {NightPatrolPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
SNOWPACK.title: Snowpack
SNOWPACK.description: Whenever a card is added to your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold], gain {SnowpackPower:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
CHAIN_POUNCE.title: Chain Pounce
CHAIN_POUNCE.description: This turn, the next {ChainPouncePower:diff()} {ChainPouncePower:plural:card|cards} brought out of your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] are played an additional time, then [gold]Exhausted[/gold].
ETERNAL_HUNT.title: Eternal Hunt
ETERNAL_HUNT.description: Each turn, you may add the first {EternalHuntPower:plural:card|{EternalHuntPower:diff()} cards} into your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] for free.
HUNT.title: Hunt
HUNT.description:
Add {Repeat:diff} [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Prey+|Prey}[/gold] into your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold].
[gold]Ambush[/gold]: Add 1 [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Prey+|Prey}[/gold] to your hand.
PREY.title: Prey
ETERNAL_BREATH.title: Eternal Breath
ETERNAL_BREATH.description: Add [gold]Breath[/gold] into your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] until it is full.
BREATH.title: Breath
FROST_THRONE.title: Frozen Throne
FROST_THRONE.description: The first time each turn you cannot afford a card's Energy cost, you may still play it. For each point of Energy you are short, gain {FrostPerEnergy:diff()} [gold]Frostbite[/gold].
FROST_BREATH.title: Frost Breath
FROST_FIELD.title: Frost Field
DEEP_WINTER.title: Deep Winter
AVALANCHE.title: Avalanche
AVALANCHE.description: Deal damage to ALL enemies equal to [blue]{Repeat:diff()}[/blue] times their [gold]Frostbite[/gold] stacks, then remove all of their [gold]Frostbite[/gold].
ICE_ARMOR.title: Snow Veil
ICE_ARMOR.description:
Whenever you apply [gold]Frostbite[/gold] to an enemy, gain [blue]{IceArmorPower:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
Whenever you are attacked without losing HP, apply [blue]{FrostbiteStacks:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Frostbite[/gold] to ALL enemies.
ICE_AGE.title: Snowfall
ICE_AGE.description: At the start of your turn, apply {IceAgePower:diff()} [gold]Frostbite[/gold] to ALL enemies.
TRAP_RECOVERY.title: Trap Recovery
TRAP_RECOVERY.description: Return all cards in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold], then gain energy equal to the sum of their costs.
LAST_STAND.title: Last Stand
LAST_STAND.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] is disabled this turn.
SNOWBALL.title: Snowball
BIG_SNOWBALL.title: Big Snowball
FROST_CLAW.title: Frost Claw
FROST_CLAW.description:
Apply {FrostbitePower:diff()} [gold]Frostbite[/gold], {Repeat:diff()} times.
For each card in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold], each application is increased by {AmbushBonus:diff()}.
FROST_DOUBLING.title: Freeze Over
FROST_DOUBLING.description: Double the [gold]Frostbite[/gold] stacks of ALL enemies without triggering its effects.
FROST_CALAMITY.title: Frost Calamity
FROST_CALAMITY.description: Whenever an enemy with [gold]Frostbite[/gold] dies, the other enemies each gain half of its stacks.
SNOWBALL_TECHNIQUE.title: Snowball Technique
SNOWBALL_GUARD.title: Snow Rampart
SNOWBALL_FIGHT.title: Snowball Fight
CARNIVAL_MOMENT.title: Carnival Moment
CARNIVAL_MOMENT.description: Your [gold]Snowball[/gold] and [gold]Big Snowball[/gold] apply {CarnivalMomentPower:diff()} additional [gold]Frostbite[/gold], and their [gold]Frostbite[/gold] effects splash to ALL enemies.
BIG_SNOWBALL_VOLLEY.title: Big Snowball!
BIG_SNOWBALL_VOLLEY.description: Add {Snowballs:diff()} [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Big Snowball+|Big Snowball}[/gold] cards to your hand.
SNOWFIELD.title: Snowfield
SNOWFIELD.description: At the start of your turn, add {SnowfieldPower:diff()} [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Big Snowball|Snowball}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
WINTER_MELT.title: Winter Melt
WINTER_MELT.description: The [gold]Frostbite[/gold] you apply no longer deals damage when it triggers, and its stacks no longer decrease.
FROST_INTENSIFY.title: Frost Intensify
FROST_INTENSIFY.description: When you apply [gold]Frostbite[/gold], your next [gold]Frostbite[/gold] this turn applies +1 stack.
SNOWBALL_LAUNCHER.title: Snowball Launcher
SNOWBALL_LAUNCHER.description:
{IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Upgrade[/gold] and play|Play} every [gold]Snowball[/gold] and [gold]Big Snowball[/gold] in your [gold]Exhaust pile[/gold] on the enemy.{InCombat:
(Plays {CalculatedSnowballs:diff()} [gold]Snowball[/gold] and {CalculatedBigSnowballs:diff()} [gold]Big Snowball[/gold])|}
ICE_SHATTER.title: Ice Shatter
ICE_BODY.title: Ice Body
SNOWFIELD_DASH.title: Snowfield Dash
SNOWFIELD_DASH.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose a card to add to your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold].
SNOWFIELD_DASH.description: Draw {Cards:diff} card(s), then choose a card in your hand to add to your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold].
SNOW_PELT.title: Snow Pelt
THICK_COAT.title: Thick Coat
THICK_COAT.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If played from your hand, add this card to your [gold]Ambush Zone[/gold].
PROBING_CLAW.title: Probing Claw
BLIZZARD.title: Blizzard
BLIZZARD.description:
Apply {FrostbitePower:diff()} [gold]Frostbite[/gold] to ALL enemies.
[gold]Ambush[/gold]: Apply {AmbushBonus:diff()} additional [gold]Frostbite[/gold] to ALL enemies.
SNOW_CALAMITY.title: Snow Calamity
SNOW_CALAMITY.description: Apply {FrostbitePower:diff()} [gold]Frostbite[/gold] to ALL enemies. Add 3 [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold].
SPINOSAURUS_FORM.title: Spinosaurus Form
SPINOSAURUS_FORM.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Remove all [gold]Frostbite[/gold] from yourself. For each stack removed, apply 1 [gold]Rend[/gold] to that enemy.
EARTHSHAKER_PALM.title: Lao Wu's Earthshaker Palm
EARTHSHAKER_PALM.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies for each card in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold].
HISS.title: Hiss
HISS.description: Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold]. If the enemy intends to [gold]Attack[/gold], apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] as well.
BODY_POUNCE.title: Tackle
BODY_POUNCE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Put the top card of your [gold]draw pile[/gold] into your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold].
CLAW_ASSAULT.title: Claw Assault
CLAW_ASSAULT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Draw {Cards:diff} card(s).
[gold]Ambush[/gold]: Draw an additional {AmbushCards:diff} card(s).
SWARM_ASSAULT.title: Swarm Assault
SWARM_ASSAULT.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each card in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold].
CHAIN_CLAW.title: Chain Claw
CHAIN_CLAW.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage 2 times.
[gold]Ambush[/gold]: The next Attack you play this turn costs 0{Energy:energyIcons()}.
SNOW_FLURRY.title: Snow Flurry
SNOW_FLURRY.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy {Repeat:diff()} times.
ICEBREAKER.title: Icebreaker
ICEBREAKER.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the target has [gold]Frostbite[/gold], deal {BonusDamage:diff()} additional damage.
SNOW_PEAK_CRUSH.title: Snowpeak Crush
SNOW_PEAK_CRUSH.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {FrostbitePower:diff()} [gold]Frostbite[/gold] to ALL enemies.
SNOWSTORM_TORRENT.title: Snowstorm Torrent
SNOWSTORM_TORRENT.description: Spend all your energy. For each energy spent, deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff} times.
FROSTBLOOM.title: Frostbloom
FROSTBLOOM.description: Apply {FrostbitePower:diff()} [gold]Frostbite[/gold]. If the target already has [gold]Frostbite[/gold], apply {FrostbloomBoost:diff()} instead.
TING_QIAO.title: Tingqiao
TING_QIAO.description: End your turn. Gain [gold]Tingqiao[/gold] until the start of your next turn.
SNOW_SIFT.title: Snow Sift
SNOW_SIFT.description: Gain {Block:diff} [gold]Block[/gold], then choose a card in your [gold]Discard pile[/gold] to add to your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold].
HOLD_FAST.title: Hold Fast
HOLD_FAST.description:
Gain {IntangiblePower:diff()} [gold]Intangible[/gold].
Costs {Energy:energyIcons()} less for each card in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold].
SNOW_SIFT.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose a card to add to your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold].
TROVE.title: Trove
TROVE.description:
Choose a card from your [gold]Draw pile[/gold] and bury it in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold].
Each time you play this card, its cost increases by 1 this combat.
ICE_MIRROR.title: Ice Mirror
ICE_MIRROR.description: Choose a card in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold]. Add {IfUpgraded:show:{Cards} copies|a copy} of it to your hand.
ICE_MIRROR.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose a card in your Ambush zone to copy.
FIERCE_POUNCE.title: Fierce Pounce
FIERCE_POUNCE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Shuffle a [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
CONCENTRATION.title: Concentration
CONCENTRATION.description: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] any number of cards from your hand, then add that many cards from your hand to your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold].
DEVOUR.title: Godspeed
DEVOUR.description: Take an extra turn. Your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold] is disabled during that turn.
ANIMAL_FRIENDS.title: Animal Friends
ANIMAL_FRIENDS.description: At the start of your turn, add a random [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Animal+|Animal}[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOTING_MOM.title: Doting Snow Leopard Mom
DOTING_MOM.description: [gold]Animal[/gold]: This turn, whenever you are attacked, deal {DotingMomPower:diff()} damage back to the attacker.
PALLAS_CAT.title: Terrifying Pallas's Cat Uncle
TIBETAN_FOX.title: Well-Read Tibetan Fox Uncle
FOX_TUTOR.title: Scholarly Fox Brother
WILD_DOG_MILK.title: Wild Dog Milk
WILD_DOG_MILK.description: When an [gold]Ambush[/gold] card is added to your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold], its [gold]Ambush[/gold] effect is unlocked immediately.
FIERCE_FOX_COMBO.title: Fierce Fox Combo
FIERCE_FOX_COMBO.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage once for each card in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold].
NATURE_BLESSING.title: Nature's Blessing
SNOW_SHELTER.title: Blizzard's Shelter
GREEDY_MARMOT.title: Greedy Marmot
DULL_YAK.title: Dull Yak
BHARAL.title: Passing Bharal
NOISY_RAVEN.title: Noisy Raven
NOISY_RAVEN.description: [gold]Animal[/gold]: Draw {IfUpgraded:show:{Cards} cards|a card}, then discard {IfUpgraded:show:{Cards} cards|a card}.
STOCKPILE.title: Stockpile
STOCKPILE.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose a card to add to your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold].
STOCKPILE.description: Choose a card in your hand to add to your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold]. Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} next turn.
SNOWDRIFT.title: Snowdrift
SNOWDRIFT.description: Gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold] for every 2 total stacks of [gold]Frostbite[/gold] on enemies.
STARGAZING.title: Stargazing
STARGAZING.description: At the start of your turn, look at the top 5 cards of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. You may put any number of them into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
VAPE.title: Vape
VAPE.description: Lose 1 [gold]Max HP[/gold]. At the start of your turn, draw 1 card.
ANIMAL_FAMILY.title: Animal Family
SWARM_AMBUSH.title: Swarm Ambush
SWARM_AMBUSH.description: At the start of your turn, all allies gain [gold]Strength[/gold] equal to the number of Attacks and [gold]Dexterity[/gold] equal to the number of Skills in your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold], until the end of their respective turns.
LUNG_ITCH.title: Everybody Lung Itch
SHARE_PREY.title: Share Prey
PET_THE_FLUFFY.title: Pet the Fluffy

AMBUSH_BARRAGE.effect.AmbushPounce: [gold]{Name}[/gold]: Attack damage hits ALL enemies and deals {Amount} more damage.
AMBUSH_BARRAGE.effect.Blizzard: [gold]{Name}[/gold]: Apply {Amount} additional Frostbite to ALL enemies.
AMBUSH_BARRAGE.effect.DeepBite: [gold]{Name}[/gold]: If the target does not intend to attack, Stun it.
AMBUSH_BARRAGE.effect.FrostFangCard: [gold]{Name}[/gold]: Lose {Secondary} HP, then deal {Amount} additional damage.

REGROUP.buryPrompt: Choose a card from your hand to add to your Ambush zone.
LINGDAWNPAO_INITIATIVE.title: Seize the Initiative
LINGDAWNPAO_INITIATIVE.description: Add {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your hand to your [gold]Ambush zone[/gold]; cards added this way immediately count as Ambushed.
LINGDAWNPAO_INITIATIVE.selectionScreenPr: Choose a card from your hand to add to your Ambush zone.
